gwt.given: No grain-id-building delegate has yet been cached for the Order model type.
gwt.when: GetDbGrainId<Order> is called twice in succession, each time with a different Order instance.
gwt.then: The first call compiles and caches the Order delegate (logging a cache miss) and the second call reuses the cached delegate (logging a cache hit), each call returning the IdSpan built from its own model instance.
